name: A. R. Duncan
bio: Dr. A. R. Duncan of Glendive, a Northern Pacific surgeon, arranged in April 1884 to come to Medora every week. In 1885 he treated Joe McCoul's fracture with a plaster splint and cared for Howard Eaton's guest Herbert Hostetter after a foot injury.

moments.label: Put a plaster splint on Joe McCoul

mentions: Dr. A. R. Duncan, surgeon of the N. P. R. R., and H. S. Davis, both of Glendive, made us a call last Friday. It is probable that Dr. Duncan will arrange for weekly visits here.
Dr. Duncan, of Glendive, last evening passed through on his way west. He will be here to-morrow or Saturday.
